headline: AI adoption is the main driver of mixed revenue growth across Indian IT services in Q2 FY27.
summary: Top‑line growth varied widely, with Coforge posting the strongest YoY increase and Infosys slowing to 1.5% YoY. Profit margins remained healthy for most firms, though some saw modest dips. AI‑related revenue and deal wins were highlighted by several companies, while guidance cuts signaled caution.

themes.title: AI‑driven growth
themes.detail: Multiple firms reported double‑digit AI revenue growth and linked it to larger deal wins.

themes.title: Guidance revisions
themes.detail: Infosys trimmed FY27 revenue guidance, reflecting slower top‑line momentum.

leaders.why: YoY revenue up 53.6% (66.6% in exchange data) and EBIT margin guidance raised to 16%.

laggards.why: Revenue growth slowed to 1.5% YoY and guidance cut to 1‑2% for FY27.
